tasks.answer: Use the shared ConfirmationDialog: required triggerButton (React element) and confirmButton (React element) plus title; body, cancelButtonText ('Cancel'), icon ('danger'|'info'), isDone are optional. For a ready-made discussion delete control, discussions.DeleteDiscussion (id, admin-gated) wraps it; the dialog primitive itself is ConfirmationDialog.

Input binds react-hook-form through its required `registration: Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn>` prop, e.g. registration={register('email')}, and must be rendered inside the <Form> wrapper so react-hook-form context and FieldWrapper's label/error handling are available.

The discussions list uses TablePagination; it requires totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl, and builds page links as rootUrl?page=N, so rootUrl must not already contain a query string (Table renders it when given a pagination prop).
MDPreview renders the Markdown body safely: it takes the required `value` string prop, parses it as Markdown and sanitizes the HTML with DOMPurify (pass raw Markdown, not pre-rendered HTML).
CreateDiscussion is an admin-only drawer form (title + Markdown body) taking no props; it requires the Authorization provider and only admins see the create trigger.
